name: The Mysterious Bookshelf
description: Investigate the strange ancient bookshelf inside the Cozy Cottage.

triggers.label: Inspect Bookshelf
triggers.tooltip: Examine the strange ancient volumes lining the cottage wall.

stages.0: Examine the bookshelf in the cozy cottage.

scenes.bodyText: A heavy wooden bookshelf lined with dusty ancient volumes. One peculiar spine glows with faint golden light.

choices.label: Pull glowing book (Arcane >= 10)
choices.tooltip: Requires 10 Arcane ability to safely dislodge the enchanted tome.

choices.label: Leave it alone.
choices.tooltip: Step back from the shelf without disturbing the mechanism.

scenes.bodyText: You channel your arcane energy to safely extract the Arcane Codex of the Forgotten Sun from the bookshelf mechanism!
